question.worked_solution:
The answer will be negative since $-18$ is negative, and we're subtracting $303$ from it.

We start by solving an easier problem:

$$
18+303
$$

Next, we carry out the addition:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  &  & \,\,\,\,\text{ }1\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  &  & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,8\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,+\,\,\,\, &  & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\,\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have 

$$
18+303=321.
$$

However, since our answer must be negative, we need to change the sign of the answer above. 

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
-18-303=-321.
$$
